purpose: Initialize and maintain all56 original finding outcomes; do not use initial status as evidence

findings.title: Ordinary-role production shortcuts reuse the same label and ID
findings.acceptance: Given only Manufacturing.Orders view access, Daily, Kanban, Orders, Planning and Imports have distinct stable labels/IDs, correct routes, no duplicate-key warnings and no additional unauthorized access.

findings.title: Report entity selectors stop at the first 200 records
findings.acceptance: Every affected report entity can be selected beyond record200; selected by-ID/inactive values survive reload, filters and failed searches; no silent first-page cap.

findings.title: Add a role-based Today workspace
findings.acceptance: Each real operator role sees relevant allowed actions/pending work, can reach all permitted modules, and has working scoped pinned/recent navigation; no fabricated pending counts.

findings.title: Extend the shared selector for large lists
findings.acceptance: Keyboard and pointer search can select remote late-page records; loading/error/empty/forbidden, stale requests, by-ID hydration and inline creation behave consistently.

findings.title: Make the dashboard action-first
findings.acceptance: Each pending-work/alert link opens the correct authorized contextual list/record; date/filter context and genuine unavailable-source state are preserved; GST links target GST context.

findings.title: Add reusable report views on top of existing URL filters
findings.acceptance: Save/reopen/update/delete a named view; favorites and chosen columns persist with intended ownership; drilldowns/back retain context; full exports reconcile with authoritative totals.

findings.title: Use task-specific table density and narrow-screen layouts
findings.acceptance: Desktop numeric entry remains efficient; phone/tablet tasks keep record identity, quantities/totals and primary action visible; preferences and columns do not hide mandatory meaning.

findings.title: Simplify password recovery and expose contextual errors
findings.acceptance: Normal reset email link supplies token without editable token input; invalid/expired links offer recovery; API errors remain contextual and field errors are announced/associated.

findings.title: Use business language and consistent next-step guidance
findings.acceptance: Ordinary users see business-facing names, helpful next-step/empty/error copy and targeted help; support/API details remain discoverable without dominating daily tasks.

findings.title: Invoice effective HSN lookup calls a method absent from the frontend service and API routes
findings.acceptance: Actual authorized classification API/client and maintenance surfaces work; cover override/default/effectivity/retire/fallback, source visibility, invoice date changes and stable-row stale-result rejection. Preserve the corrected current diagnosis.

findings.title: First-200 static dropdowns hide valid masters and records
findings.acceptance: All affected Item/Party/bill/category/unit selections can find records201+, retain inactive selected history and select a just-created object without first-page reload dependency.

findings.title: Supplier changes do not clear/revalidate existing allocations and bill requests can race
findings.acceptance: Switch supplier A→B while requests complete in reverse order; no A bill/allocation survives in B's payment; totals and unallocated amount reconcile; API rejects cross-supplier IDs.

findings.title: Return against bill asks operator to repeat supplier and line information
findings.acceptance: Return initiated from source prefills supplier, exact original line IDs and units; remaining returnable quantity accounts for earlier returns; financial/physical effects are explicit and conserved.

findings.title: Purchase detail actions ignore document state
findings.acceptance: For every real purchase state, UI offers only valid permitted actions with blocked reasons; direct API calls independently reject invalid transitions and retain authoritative detail on failure.

findings.title: Sales and purchase page forms collapse API validation into toast
findings.acceptance: Server field/row/business errors persist after toast expiry, focus/jump to the affected input, retain all entry and distinguish failed from uncertain submission.

findings.title: Long forms navigate away without unsaved-change protection
findings.acceptance: Dirty page/modal changes survive or are explicitly discarded across Back/Cancel/route/refresh; successful save clears draft/guard; list filter/scroll return context is restored.

findings.title: GST issuance workflow is explicitly incomplete
findings.acceptance: Required supported GST issuance/session/extension flows use real backend/provider contracts and sandbox evidence. Missing access is an explicit unexecuted gate, never a local fake success or completed disabled button.

findings.title: Item manufacturing uses UTC calendar date while newer workflows use company business date
findings.acceptance: Legacy Item manufacture and new order flows use verified company business date consistently around local midnight, night shift, backdating and effective BOM boundaries.

findings.title: Two production entry paths coexist inside and outside Item master
findings.acceptance: All three production concepts have recognizable labels, stock-effect explanations, correct primary path and history access; an OEE reading never silently records stock output.

findings.title: Document and cash ledgers require wide horizontal tables
findings.acceptance: At phone width users can identify/edit invoice/purchase/cash line context and save with visible totals/actions; desktop grid and keyboard behavior remain intact.

findings.title: Inline master creation reloads lists but does not select the newly created record
findings.acceptance: Creating an Item/Party/Category/Unit/other supported inline master returns and selects its canonical ID/object in the originating field and restores focus without losing other values.

findings.title: GST setup/support asks operators to know internal IDs and exact strings
findings.acceptance: Choose company/registration/GSTIN through authorized human-readable lookups; show enumerated operation/status meanings and contextual document/support links; raw IDs are optional details.

findings.title: Item stock controls rewrite decimal strings via JavaScript Number
findings.acceptance: Supported quantity boundary strings round-trip exactly; excess scale/range is rejected or explicitly rounded under documented rule; blur never silently rewrites high-precision/large values.

findings.title: Expense category and daily cash workflows are separate families without visible origin guidance
findings.acceptance: Document the authoritative expense path and resulting source-linked cash effects; test manual versus automatic behavior and prove no duplicate expense/stock/wallet postings are introduced.

findings.title: Rojmel transaction and wallet labels disagree with backend enums
findings.acceptance: Assert actual backend contract values independently: transaction5 OpeningBalance/6 AdjustmentIn/7 AdjustmentOut; wallet4 PettyCash/5 BankCash; Posted status. Verify badges, filter payloads, creation and reports.

findings.title: Party type is omitted from create/edit payload even though grouped customer/supplier flows depend on it
findings.acceptance: Create Customer, Supplier and Both, including contextual quick-create; edit preserves existing type unless intentionally changed; backend persistence and lookup eligibility agree.

findings.title: Party setting flags are persisted without a connected form or print behavior
findings.acceptance: Each exposed Party setting has a specified, observable, persisted effect in its consuming UI/print/workflow; related external capability gaps stay explicit and cannot be closed by persisting a checkbox.

findings.title: Daily typed quantities have no unsaved-work protection
findings.acceptance: Type/paste multiple orders, change route/reload and recover correct user/company/version-scoped draft; counts distinguish pending/reviewed/saved; recovered rows never auto-post.

findings.title: Several selectors and repair queues only load the first 200 records
findings.acceptance: Late-page resources/runs/packaging/BOM versions and legacy production history are discoverable with correct totals/errors; validate actual pagination per endpoint, including unpaged BOM Issues.

findings.title: Packaging creation says saved before the nested verification step is discoverable
findings.acceptance: Create a profile then immediately discover and complete conversion verification or handoff to approver; list/detail accurately shows readiness and a worked unit conversion.

findings.title: Three production-entry concepts need an explicit business distinction
findings.acceptance: Order-based actuals, legacy Item stock production and OEE readings are explicitly differentiated; compatibility/history strategy is documented and duplicate physical posting is prevented.

findings.title: OEE Off means skipped; deliberate no-production cannot be acknowledged in this grid
findings.acceptance: A no-production/planned-stop acknowledgement is distinguishable from an unentered/skipped reading in UI and reporting; all-off day can be intentionally completed where required without fabricated readings.

findings.title: Production detail exposes resource IDs and technical evidence before business names
findings.acceptance: Workers identify Item, machine/mould/shift/work-centre/operation names, due date and remaining quantity before technical IDs; lookup failures and historical snapshots are truthful.

findings.title: Finalized dispatch planning does not guide users directly into linked shipment creation
findings.acceptance: Finalize a run then open linked shipment creation with correct run/warehouse/remaining allocation; existing partial shipments and permissions are reflected; no duplicate conversion.

findings.title: Transporter request failures silently become an empty transporter list
findings.acceptance: Transporter network/403/server failures visibly differ from no configured transporters; retry preserves all other shipment input and links to the existing Party role.

findings.title: Operational production report primary export is NDJSON
findings.acceptance: Open a CSV/XLSX operational export in common spreadsheet tooling; human headings, dates, units and quality flags match all filtered authoritative rows/totals; NDJSON stays optional.

findings.title: Policy forms expose many mathematical and logistics fields without a worked outcome
findings.acceptance: Basic/Advanced policy forms and worked examples accurately explain effective precedence, rounding, lead duration and physical units using the same actual business calculations.

findings.title: OEE custom modal headings are not connected to the dialog name; editing stays enabled while saving
findings.acceptance: OEE dialogs announce their correct title and labels, trap/restore focus and follow deliberate busy-save/Cancel behavior; in-flight save cannot misleadingly apply after unacknowledged edits.

findings.title: Cross-module setup and shipment execution need a permission-aware next-action checklist
findings.acceptance: Readiness distinguishes missing data, missing permission, pending approval and failed load; each actionable blocker links to existing setup and returns to the original work.

findings.title: Legacy Item production Post/Cancel checks Edit in UI but Approve in API
findings.acceptance: View/create/edit/approve-only and combined roles are tested against nested Item UI and real API; draft editing and stock post/reversal use their own canonical capabilities.

findings.title: Approved BOM end-effectivity command has no dedicated frontend action
findings.acceptance: Approved End validity date uses the dedicated BOM endpoint, handles date/version conflicts, affects future applicability and preserves prior frozen orders/history.

findings.title: Legacy packing recovery requires removing allocations but normal packing offers no removal
findings.acceptance: Reproduce legacy packing blocker and resolve it through normal draft edit/remove/repack UI/API; allocations reconcile atomically, stale/repeated requests are safe, dispatched/posted packages remain protected.

findings.title: Dirty daily work can be silently discarded by changing context
findings.acceptance: Attendance date, Data Book sheet/view and permission role switches cannot silently reset unsaved work; paste remains explicitly reviewable; draft recovery and successful clearing are tested.

findings.title: HR approvals and corrections expose internal IDs instead of business context
findings.acceptance: Corrections/approvals begin from actual employee/date/leave/payroll context with internal IDs bound; approver sees values, reason, period and totals before decision.

findings.title: Core HR results remain raw JSON
findings.acceptance: Balances show entitlement/used/remaining by leave type; payslip shows employee/period/earnings/deductions/net with usable print/download; raw JSON is not the normal result.

findings.title: Multi-request saves can leave partly completed account or employee setup
findings.acceptance: Force second-step role/bank failure; first saved entity is clearly retained and refreshed; retry completes only the missing step, without duplicate user/employee create or misleading generic failure.

findings.title: Employee onboarding has too much work in its first save
findings.acceptance: Essential employee creation works with optional sections deferred; completion checklist and existing drafts/inline masters work; profile PDF only downloads when explicitly selected.

findings.title: Website content editors need a faithful public preview
findings.acceptance: Draft post/product/announcement preview faithfully reflects public rendering, assets and responsive appearance, with safe content handling and no premature real publish.

findings.title: Website settings expose technical keys and untyped values
findings.acceptance: Known website keys have friendly typed controls/examples, invalid values cannot save, dirty refresh is protected and public/private changes are clearly reviewed; backend key restrictions remain.

findings.title: Public scheduling asks Indian client staff to enter UTC manually
findings.acceptance: A chosen local publishing/start/end time round-trips through UTC storage and displays in the configured timezone; boundary, invalid interval and timezone-label cases are covered.

findings.title: Personal/browser preferences and business configuration look similar
findings.acceptance: Preferences clearly identify browser/account/company scope, apply/reload as advertised, and manufacturing display preference cannot be mistaken for actual backend company/runtime setup.

findings.title: Several helpful summaries do not take the operator to the next task
findings.acceptance: HR pending cards open correct filtered work, created Role can continue to its matrix, and inline Blog Category create selects the new category and preserves the draft.

findings.title: Technical implementation messages appear in ordinary client UI
findings.acceptance: Warranty/profile/blog messages explain available next action in client language; necessary technical diagnostics are available in support detail without replacing user guidance.

findings.title: Payroll and leave side-panel queries need visible labels
findings.acceptance: Employee/month/year/manager controls have explicit visible/accessible labels, logical focus order and named results; errors associate with the correct control.

findings.title: Payroll setup is a database foundation without an operator maintenance flow
findings.acceptance: Salary and leave setup persist through real authorized APIs/UI; effective overlaps/amounts are validated; payroll preflight lists included/missing staff and processing cannot silently exclude or half-process them.

findings.title: Department attendance report has no discovered operator surface
findings.acceptance: Department summary reuses the actual reporting endpoint, supports date/department filters and contextual employee drilldown/back, and is permission-aware.
